The '''Alderaanian Parliament''' was a governing body on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The parliament was founded after [[King/Legends|King]] [[Darrus Alde]] united the planet under his rule early in its history, prior to the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="History of Alderaan" /><ref name="TORCKing" /> Only members from the noble houses of Alderaan were eligible to serve in the parliament.<ref name="TORCNoble">{{TORcite|type=codex|Noble Houses}}</ref><ref name="Elysium" /> The nobility of Alderaan were responsible for ruling the planet and choosing the reigning monarch in often vicious, always intricate games of local politics. Each noble house bore the family name of its original founders, and many nobles traced their lineage back over hundreds of generations. However, noble blood was not a requirement for house membership; in less traditional houses, it was not unheard of for an ambitious servant or farmer to rise above his or her station.<ref name="TORCNoble" />

After the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] that ended the [[Great Galactic War]] and Alderaan's subsequent withdrawal from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Prince/Legends|Crown prince]] of Alderaan, [[Gaul Panteer]]&mdash;who personally withdrew Alderaan from the Republic in protest over the treaty&mdash;was assassinated; the [[Silara Panteer|queen]] died a few days later.<ref name="Alderaan" />

With no monarch and no heir, the parliament was tasked with deciding which of Alderaan's noble houses would inherit the throne. The legislature became deadlocked, leading one of the houses to decide to settle the matter by force. This house's actions led to one of the [[Alderaan Civil War|bloodiest civil wars]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history.<ref name="Alderaan" />
